summary: Producer-reported 0.4.0 source candidate; historical cards and manager decisions preserved.
current_focus: Review independent subcomponents and matching consumer adapters; no deployment.

manager_review.notes: Starter state created locally; manager/QA review is still required.

roadmap.title: Define the next bounded implementation pass
roadmap.summary: Collect the latest project state and convert it into one reviewable implementation slice.
acceptance_criteria: The manager/QA session has reviewed the current project state.
The next pass has a bounded scope and screenshot/log/code-verifiable acceptance criteria.
Worker execution and promotion remain explicitly gated.

roadmap.title: Source-aware discovery lifecycle
roadmap.summary: Extend existing observation with stable Git/local/HTTPS provenance, explicit withdrawal and temporary-failure safety.
acceptance_criteria: Run Git/local/HTTPS fixture tests and verify only Git has a real commit revision.
Confirm invalid/unreachable sidecars retain last valid intent; explicit removal withdraws.

roadmap.title: Durable deployment-bound sender
roadmap.summary: Persistent intent, sequence/CAS, retry/restart reconciliation and strict authenticated v2 exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Run lost-ack/restart/supersession tests; the same retry operation is reused.
Confirm wrong credentials/binding/acknowledgement cannot clear pending work or prevent API activation.

roadmap.title: Shared Atrium v2 handoff
roadmap.summary: Versioned schemas, fixtures and explicit matching-release acceptance; no claim that receiver is installed.
acceptance_criteria: Validate shared schemas/examples and review receiver requirements against the matching Atrium release.
Confirm this ZIP neither deploys nor claims legacy apps:approve intake supports v2.

roadmap.title: Matching Atrium v2 release
roadmap.summary: Atrium owner must implement machine binding, real candidate transactions, replay/tombstones and shared fixture conformance.

roadmap.title: Independent staging and operator acceptance
roadmap.summary: After receiver release, provision scoped credentials and generic deployment metadata; test live staging without modifying production in this pass.

roadmap.title: Generic optional service registrations and scoped reader
roadmap.summary: Additive optional registration contract and generic authorized pull reader.
acceptance_criteria: Declare any service without installing a consumer; verify API activation remains independent.
Read only the authenticated service declarations/documents and verify root-relative pinning, safe outage retention and restart/removal behavior.

roadmap.title: Consumer-owned generic registration reader integration
roadmap.summary: Atrium/other service owners implement their own scoped polling, metadata validation and durable reconciliation before replacing legacy delivery.

roadmap.title: Independent nested components
roadmap.summary: Generic independent child source trees and mounts.
acceptance_criteria: Verify isolated child data/authentication and explicitly bound service calls.
Verify nested HTTP/WebSocket/OpenAPI/CORS and registration document locations.
Verify failure retention, restart, explicit subtree removal, identity collisions and bounded source reads.
